title: How a Sink P-Trap Prevents Gas Backflow
description: Sink drainage relies on a curved fitting called a P-trap to balance wastewater disposal with indoor air safety. As water flows down the sink tailpiece, momentum carries waste past the dip and into the wall drain line. When water flow stops, gravity retains a precise volume of clean water in the curved bend. This trapped liquid forms a continuous physical seal against sewer gases. Proper installation requires correct vertical alignment and adequate downstream venting to prevent siphoning, ensuring the protective water barrier stays intact after every rinse.
